title: Mazzoth
html_source:
Feast of Mazzoth: in EX 12 Mazzoth is combined with Passover as a historical feast commemorating the deliverance of Israel from Egypt. Only unleavened bread (matzoth) was to be eaten for a week beginning with the day of Passover.

For those who are aware of Christian roots in Jewish ritual, the Jewish matzo used at Passover is analogous to unleavened bread required for the Roman Rite of Communion.
